title: Evaluating the effects of COVID-19 lockdowns on air quality across some African countries
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2026, 6,533-550
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00111K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zizhen Han, Yuqiang Zhang, Zhou Liu, Kexin Zhang, Stanley Numbonui Tasheh, Narcisse Tchinda Tsona, Zhuyi Wang, Bin Luo, Likun Xue, Xinfeng Wang
To test emission reductions via COVID-19 lockdown air quality changes in Africa, JPL chemical reanalysis data reveal mixed pollutant trends. Natural and anthropogenic drivers are highlighted, urging stricter emission rules and clean energy use.
